newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-UNDERWOOD "TOUCH AND GO" FOR LIONS TOUR.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-UNDERWOOD "TOUCH AND GO" FOR LIONS TOUR.

text.p: England wing Tony Underwood said on Monday his chances of making the British Lions tour to South Africa were "touch and go" after having his jaw broken during a second division league match on Saturday.
"It doesn't mean the end of my chances as it could be healed by May when the Lions leave," said Underwood who was named last week as one of four wings in the 35-strong Lions tour party.
"Nothing has been displaced and the doctors say it should knit together in the next two or three weeks.
"Obviously I will need another couple of weeks after that to get up to match fitness again so it's going to be very much touch and go."
Underwood, playing for Newcastle, had to leave the field after he was hit by a high tackle from Bedford wing Paul Hewitt.
The British Lions leave for South Africa on May 17.
